summary.text: Heidi Heino is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a corporate business leader, entrepreneur, mother and grandmother.

paragraphs.text: Heino's Ballotpedia profile lists a bachelor's degree from Colorado State University in 1997 and two graduate degrees from Concordia University, Saint Paul, in 2017 and 2023, and gives her profession as director of business development.
In the survey, she said she has spent more than a decade solving complex problems, leading partnership negotiations and managing a department.

Heino said her campaign focuses on accountability and transparency in government, including a proposal she calls the Minnesota Integrity in Government Act, as well as education and lowering the cost of living.
She also said she is passionate about seniors and children, rooting out fraud, and clean, affordable and reliable energy, including nuclear.
Her Republican primary was canceled, and she advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
